invariants.rationale: The method throws an exception if node is null, so node is always non-null at exit.

The method returns true if this is node or a descendant, otherwise false. (Where isDescendantOfHelper would be the predicate representing walking up the parent chain, but can only refer to the exposed method contract.)
Rephrasing invariant using 'hasAncestor' as a conceptual alias for traversing parents.
Again, stating that the result is true iff node is in the parent chain (or this).
If result is false, then this != node and node is not an ancestor (via parent links).
